question: What does "unity in diversity" mean in the context of Nepal?
actual_answer: It means the collective harmony and unified coexistence among different castes, religions, languages, cultures and traditions, accepting differences as strength while taking pride in one shared national identity.

question: नेपालमा कति जातजातिहरूको बसोबास छ?
actual_answer: नेपालमा १२५ भन्दा बढी जातजातिहरूको बसोबास छ। संविधान २०७२ ले तीमध्ये ५९ जातजातिहरूलाई आदिवासी जनजातिको मान्यता दिएको छ।

question: How many languages are spoken in Nepal?
actual_answer: More than 123 languages are spoken in Nepal. Nepali is the national language, but other languages such as Maithili, Bhojpuri, Tharu, Tamang, Newari, Magar, Awadhi, Limbu, Gurung and Sanskrit are also widely used and constitutionally recognised.

question: नेपालका तीन मुख्य भौगोलिक क्षेत्रहरू के के हुन्?
actual_answer: नेपालका तीन मुख्य भौगोलिक क्षेत्रहरू तराई मैदान (उचाइ ६७–३०० मिटर, उष्णकटिबन्धीय जलवायु), पहाडी क्षेत्र (उचाइ ३००–३००० मिटर, समशीतोष्ण जलवायु) र हिमाली क्षेत्र (उचाइ ३०००–८८४८ मिटर, शीतोष्ण जलवायु) हुन्।

question: Which major religions coexist in Nepal?
actual_answer: Nepal is a secular country where Hindu, Buddhist, Islam, Kirat, Christian, Sikh and Bon religions coexist. Lumbini, the birthplace of Gautam Buddha, along with sites like Pashupatinath, Swayambhunath and Boudhanath, are shared centres of faith for followers of different religions.

question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय एकताका मुख्य स्तम्भहरू के के हुन्?
actual_answer: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय एकताका मुख्य स्तम्भहरू संविधान, राष्ट्रिय भाषा नेपाली, साझा संस्कृति र ऐतिहासिक एकताको भावना हुन्। संविधान २०७२ ले सबै जातजाति, भाषा र संस्कृतिको संरक्षण र सम्वर्द्धनको प्रत्याभूति गरेको छ।

question: What are the main challenges to national unity in Nepal mentioned in the document?
actual_answer: The main challenges are social conflict arising from ethnic, regional and linguistic differences, political instability, economic inequality between regions and communities, a cultural crisis from modernization threatening traditional cultures, and the political misuse of diversity.

question: संविधान २०७२ ले के को ग्यारेन्टी गरेको छ?
actual_answer: संविधान २०७२ ले सबै जातजाति र भाषाको संरक्षणको ग्यारेन्टी गरेको छ, र संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रले विविधतालाई स्थान दिएको छ।

question: What solutions are proposed to address the challenges to unity?
actual_answer: The proposed solutions are inclusive politics ensuring equal participation of all communities, inclusive development creating equal economic opportunity across regions, active state protection of all languages and cultures, intercultural dialogue to build harmony and mutual understanding, and including national unity values in education.

question: निष्कर्षमा नेपालको राष्ट्रिय नारा के हुनुपर्छ भनिएको छ?
actual_answer: निष्कर्षमा भनिएको छ कि "एकतामा बल, विविधतामा शान" यही नै नेपालको राष्ट्रिय नारा हुनुपर्छ, किनकि विविधता नेपालको शान हो र एकता नेपालको जान हो।
